items.rationale: Clause 7.1.7(f) covers the first travel charge on the repair contractor’s invoice. One flat rate at €81.
Clause 7.1.7(c) covers sealing material used in the pipe repair. One piece at €26.
Clause 2.4.3(a) covers the failed indoor supply pipe, and 7.1.7(c) allows like-for-like replacement. One metre at the €42 full-cover rate.
Clause 7.1.7(c) covers reinstatement of the insulation on the repaired pipe. One metre at the €26 full-cover rate.

Clause 7.1.7(g) covers necessary installation labour if it is distinct from the technician time; 7.1.8(c) bars duplicate labour charges. The conditional estimate is one invoiced hour at the supplied €480 installation rate.
Clause 7.1.7(g) covers technician labour for the repair. Nine invoiced labour units at €92 each, consistent with the comparable technician rates.
Clauses 7.1.7(b) and (e) cover necessary drying and one equipment deployment charge per operation. One flat rate at the €580 full-cover level.

items.description: Close the wall opening and paint the patch
items.rationale: Clauses 7.1.5 and 7.1.7(a) cover making good the access opening and repainting the affected patch. One repair at the €633 full-cover level.

Clause 7.1.6 does not extend cover to the unaffected part of the wall because matching paint was available, and the patch is already billed on line 8. If covered, the full line would be 8 m² at €25/m².

items.description: Repaint the remaining walls and ceiling
items.rationale: Clauses 7.1.5 and 7.1.6 exclude repainting separate, undamaged surfaces solely to match. If covered, the estimate would be one flat rate of €650.
